cmd: echo '=== початок Caddyfile ==='; head -30 /root/Caddyfile; echo; echo '=== чи є timeout у Caddy ==='; grep -n -i 'timeout\|transport' /root/Caddyfile | head; echo; echo '=== Caddy у docker? ==='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Ports}}' 2>&1 | head -5; echo; echo '=== через Caddy локально ==='; host=$(grep -m1 -oE '^[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}' /root/Caddyfile); echo "домен: $host"; curl -sk -m 400 -H "Host: $host" -o /tmp/s.json -w 'HTTP=%{http_code} час=%{time_total}s\n' https://127.0.0.1/sync; head -c 500 /tmp/s.json
